description: Write an r2modman / Thunderstore Mod Manager profile file (.r2z) that can be imported via 'Import profile > From file'. Optionally resolves dependencies and bundles config files. Does not upload anything.

community.description: Thunderstore community identifier, e.g. "lethal-company", "riskofrain2", "valheim". Use list_communities to discover.

configFiles.description: Map of relative path (e.g. "BepInEx/config/foo.cfg") to file contents

disabled.description: Mods to include but mark disabled

name: export_r2modman_profile
title: Export r2modman profile
